data_objects.name: encoded_passenger_features
data_objects.meaning: Passenger-level feature records in which class, sex, age, fare, embarkation, title, and traveling-alone status are represented by compact integer encodings.
data_objects.notes: The table has no passenger identifier, and several fields are encoded categories or bins rather than raw measurements.

variables.name: Sex
variables.meaning: Binary integer code for passenger sex; code-to-label mapping is absent.

variables.name: Age
variables.meaning: Ordinal age-band code rather than age in years; bin boundaries are not supplied.

variables.name: Fare
variables.meaning: Ordinal fare-band code rather than a monetary fare amount; bin boundaries are not supplied.

variables.name: Embarked
variables.meaning: Integer-coded embarkation category; port mapping is absent.

variables.name: Title
variables.meaning: Integer-coded passenger-title category; title grouping and mapping are absent.

variables.name: IsAlone
variables.meaning: Binary integer indicator of whether the passenger is traveling alone.

variables.name: Age*Pclass
variables.meaning: Interaction value equal to the encoded Age band multiplied by Pclass.

structure.description: Each row is an encoded passenger feature vector, but no source identifier is available to establish a row key or link to another table.
Age*Pclass is a deterministic interaction of two existing encoded fields; Age and Fare remain category codes, not continuous measurements.

uncertainties: Code-to-label mappings for Sex, Embarked, Title, and IsAlone are not documented.
Age and Fare bin edges and the ordering or grouping rules for Title are not supplied.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv and its neutral packet were used as evidence.
